## History

Phillips secured his teaching position thanks to his uncle, a school trustee, and boarded at Eben Wright's house. During his time as the schoolmaster, he disciplined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by forcing her to stand at the blackboard after she smashed a slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head, and later made her sit with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for being late. On his final day of teaching, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to his students.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/minnie-andrews--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as a mentor to [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) during his time as the schoolmaster in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He leads her and the rest of the class through their studies up until his final day at the school, where he delivers a heartfelt farewell speech to the students.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +6 more_
